tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows markedly elevated NT-proBNP, suggesting possible heart failure or significant cardiac strain. Mild normocytic anemia is present (low RBC, hemoglobin), with low serum iron but normal ferritin, possibly indicating anemia of chronic disease. HbA1c is elevated, consistent with diabetes. Mildly low total CO₂ may suggest metabolic acidosis. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Recommend clinical correlation for cardiac status, diabetes management, and further evaluation of anemia.
